subject: Request: executive advocacy packet & reference for NimbusPay renewal
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Cecilia Hart <cecilia.hart@nimbuspayout.com>, Julian Park <julian.park@nimbuspayout.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Executive packet for upcoming renewal / expansion ask

Hi Cecilia / Julian,

Congrats again on the successful pilot wrap — usage scaled nicely in May and I know the exec team is starting to ask for a short, finance-friendly package to take into the renewal discussion. Cecilia mentioned this morning she'd like something concise to share with the CFO and Head of Ops that demonstrates the realized ROI and the projected delta if we expand to the Payments Reconciliation flow.

Could you confirm the target audience (CFO + Head of Ops vs. full leadership), and whether a one-page executive note + a 3-slide outcomes deck would be sufficient? I attached the quick ROI snapshot we ran against the pilot data earlier (nimbuspay_roi_snapshot_v2.pdf).

Proposed next steps:
- We deliver an exec one-pager and a 3-slide outcomes deck by EOD next Tuesday (6/15).
- We arrange a 30-min internal briefing with your CFO / head of Ops on week of 6/21.
- We provide a short customer advocate intro (1 reference call, ~20 mins) from a peer who used our reconciliation workflow.

Attachments: [attachment: nimbuspay_roi_snapshot_v2.pdf (PDF, 140KB)]
Related: https://redwood.drive/shared/exec-brief-nimbuspay

If that's aligned, I can loop Marissa from CS to prep the pack and Ben from SE to add the architecture slide.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0126

--
Redwood Inference | Make inference predictable and economical
From: Cecilia Hart <cecilia.hart@nimbuspayout.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive packet for upcoming renewal / expansion ask

Thanks, Rafael — this is helpful.

Audience: CFO (Meera Zhao), Head of Ops (Julian), and the Head of Product (all three will be at the 6/28 renewal review). A one-pager + 3-slide outcomes deck sounds perfect. The CFO will want to see ARR impact, time-savings translated into FTE equivalence, and any risk/migration notes.

About reference: yes, a peer conversation would be valuable. Ideally someone who can speak specifically to the reconciliation workflow ROI (not just general platform praise).

Timeline: can you get the packet to me by EOD 6/15? Also can you include a one-line summary I can copy into an internal memo?

Finally, we'll need a short list of pricing options for the expanded scope (baseline + +20% volume + full reconciliation). I know you already shared a draft in HubSpot, but please include a simple pricing snapshot in the packet.

Cc'ing Julian for visibility.

Cheers,
Cecilia Hart
VP, Finance Operations | NimbusPay
cecilia.hart@nimbuspayout.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Cecilia Hart <cecilia.hart@nimbuspayout.com>, Julian Park <julian.park@nimbuspayout.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive packet for upcoming renewal / expansion ask

Cecilia / Julian — thanks, noted. Looping in Marissa (Customer Success) and Ben (SE) to assemble the deliverables.

Marissa / Ben — can you help with the following items for NimbusPay?
1) One-page executive summary (low-jargon, CFO-focused) with: realized monthly savings ($), FTE-equivalent reduction, and projected incremental ARR for the proposed expansion.
2) 3-slide outcomes deck: a) Pilot highlights + metrics, b) ROI / forecast model (2-year view), c) Proposed implementation timeline + risks + mitigation.
3) A single architecture slide (Ben) showing the reconciliation flow and where Redwood sits (KV-cache + batching notes).
4) A short pricing snapshot (baseline, +20% throughput, full reconciliation scope).
5) A reference call: we should offer a 20-min peer call (ideally next week). I recall Marissa had a contact at Greenline Health who ran a similar workflow.

I attached a fillable executive brief template and the ROI snapshot we ran earlier.

Attachments: [attachment: exec-brief-packet.docx (DOCX, 85KB)], [attachment: nimbuspay_roi_snapshot_v2.pdf (PDF, 140KB)]
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/NIM-2026-EXP-02

If EOD 6/15 is tight for any reason, flag a date you can commit to.

Thanks — Rafael
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Cecilia Hart <cecilia.hart@nimbuspayout.com>, Julian Park <julian.park@nimbuspayout.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive packet for upcoming renewal / expansion ask

Hi all — happy to take point on the advocacy packet. Rafael, I've pulled an outcomes one-pager and will tailor it to show:
- Realized average reduction in reconciliation time per transaction (Greenline data + Nimbus pilot numbers)
- Modeled FTE savings at current and +20% volume
- A short risk checklist and rollback options for staged rollout

I can be the reference contact on a short peer call. For context, Greenline Health (Samir Patel) ran an identical reconciliation rollout in Q4 2026 and saw a 38% reduction in manual match time — Samir can speak to the timeline and quantifiable operational impact.

I've attached the tailored executive brief and asked Ben to add the architecture slide this afternoon.

Attachments: [attachment: exec-brief-packet.docx (updated) (DOCX, 92KB)], [attachment: solution-arch-diagram.png (PNG, 420KB)]

Proposed reference window: Samir Patel (Greenline Health) is available 6/22 or 6/24 between 10:00 - 12:00 PT for a 20-min call. Rafael — if that works for Nimbus, I'll email Samir to confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

- Reference call: Tentatively scheduled with Samir Patel (Greenline) on 6/22 at 10:30 PT — Marissa will send the calendar invite and Samir's dial-in info.
- Pricing snapshot included (three options). Cecilia, I'll also send a one-line memo you can paste into your internal deck: "Redwood reduced manual reconciliation time by 38% in a comparable customer deployment; projected +$420k net benefit over 24 months at NimbusPay’s current volume."
- I added a DocuSign link for the scoped expansion SOW (no signature required until after your internal review): https://docusign.com/NDxY-12345 (placeholder).
